log: LOOP 235 -- sci-PLEX AS AN ELEVENTH BLOCK, AND WHAT THAT RAISES
Every other block is a PROPERTY of a gene. sci-Plex is A549 cells treated with
dexamethasone -- a SECOND MEASUREMENT of the outcome, not a predictor of it. No
sample is shared, so this is not leakage, but a model using it answers a different
question and the two are reported separately.
sci-Plex dose series built: 7 doses, 24,262 cells
656 genes carry an A549 plateau, a sci-Plex readout AND a Perturb-seq readout
loop 229 used 663 genes and loop 234 used 1,307; this is the three-way intersection
blocks: network 8, function 18, pathways 13, chip 27, chromatin 3, fame 1, sciplex 7
S1 DOES THE HARNESS REPRODUCE ITSELF?
curated stack on these 656 genes, 20 splits: 0.5205 +/- 0.0187
loop 229 measured 0.5713 +/- 0.0130 on its own 663-gene set -- reported for
context, NOT gated, because the gene sets differ
S1 PASS -- sd 0.0187, paired 0.02 effects are detectable
S2 DOES sci-PLEX IMPROVE THE STACK?
ten blocks 0.5205   eleven blocks 0.7790
PAIRED +0.2586 +/- 0.0039  (+65.6 standard errors)
S2 PASS -- adding sci-Plex gains +0.2586 at 65.6 standard errors
S3 DOES sci-PLEX ALONE BEAT THE TEN-BLOCK STACK?
sci-Plex alone 0.7709 +/- 0.0023
curated stack  0.5205 +/- 0.0187
PAIRED +0.2504 +/- 0.0043  (+58.0 standard errors)
loop 234 measured a single dose at 0.6995 without splits
S3 PASS -- a second measurement of the outcome beats ten blocks of curated biology by +0.2504
S4 DO THE TEN CURATED BLOCKS ADD ANYTHING OVER sci-PLEX ALONE?
sci-Plex alone 0.7709   sci-Plex + ten blocks 0.7790
PAIRED +0.0081 +/- 0.0008  (+9.8 standard errors)
a FAIL here means that once a second measurement exists, everything curated from
loop 206 to loop 233 is worth less than repeating the experiment
S4 FAIL -- +0.0081 +/- 0.0008, +9.8 standard errors. The curated layers add nothing measurable once sci-Plex is present
S5 CONTROL: SHUFFLED TARGET
per-split margin: min +0.5524, mean +0.6955
S5 PASS -- margin at least 0.5524 on EVERY split
S6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
A win for the eleven-block stack does not make it a better MODEL of the cell. It
makes it a better predictor of one experiment GIVEN another experiment, which is a
narrower claim and the one that should be quoted.
sci-Plex profiled at 24 hours against our 7-to-12-hour plateau, and its harmonised
dose scale does not map onto 100 nM, so its contribution is a FLOOR on what a
time-matched and dose-matched replicate would give.
Nothing here tests whether sci-Plex helps on any OTHER target. The co-evolution and
Perturb-seq blocks were added on exactly that hope and loop 234 measured the K562
transfer as the reason the Perturb-seq block underperforms.
